name: dev.auth4.sdk
description: Game authentication for auth4.dev: device login, Apple Game Center sign-in, guest sessions with safe upgrades by email or social providers (in the system browser, or a popup in WebGL builds), adding, changing or removing a verified email address on a signed-in account, and rotating refresh tokens kept in memory unless a secure storage adapter is supplied.

samples.description: A scene with device login, guest play, saving guest progress and sign-out using in-memory tokens.
Game Center sign-in on iOS and macOS, saving guest progress to Game Center and the verified email step, with an adapter for Apple's GameKit plug-in.
